visual_structure.core: A volumetric holographic energy form made from multiple continuous ribbon-like surfaces, not wings and not a solid sphere.

ribbons.count: approximately 3 visually dominant interwoven ribbon surfaces
ribbons.geometry: closed or looping smooth 3D-like surfaces with broad curved contours; each ribbon should fold, cross and pass behind/in front of the others
ribbons.upper_arch: rises from the left-center, peaks around x=0.56, y=0.16, then descends toward the right-center
ribbons.lower_fold: broad luminous loop crossing the lower center, with a low point around x=0.54, y=0.80
ribbons.side_loops: rounded lateral folds extending to approximately x=0.19 on the left and x=0.82 on the right
ribbons.depth_order: split each ribbon into front/back segments at crossings; use masks or clipping so overlap order changes along the path

surface.mesh: dense curved point lattice following each ribbon surface in rows and columns
surface.density: high, with thousands of tiny cyan/blue points; points follow the surface curvature rather than random scatter
surface.edge: bright cyan/blue/violet rim highlights, stronger at folds and crossings
surface.fill: semi-transparent blue and violet gradients with darker translucent interior

central_waveform.appearance: thin horizontal cyan line with a symmetric, sharply peaked audio waveform; brightest at the center
central_waveform.integration: waveform sits in the open central cavity and remains visually separate from the ribbon surfaces

outer_orbits.style: subtle, sparse and secondary; do not become the dominant shape

visual_structure.particles: small cyan, blue and occasional violet points around the core and along the ribbon surfaces

animation.idle: slow continuous flow of mesh points along ribbon surfaces, subtle ribbon undulation, slow orbit movement, gentle waveform breathing
animation.listening: waveform reacts with faster, more pronounced amplitude; cyan highlights intensify
animation.processing: mesh flow and internal particles accelerate; layered glow pulses in blue
animation.speaking: waveform animates rhythmically and prominently; ribbon movement remains smooth
animation.executing: faster particle circulation and stronger violet/blue energy accents
animation.offline: reduce brightness, slow movement significantly, retain a faint visible silhouette

implementation_constraints: Do not display the PNG as the final animated core.
Use the PNG only as a visual reference during implementation.
Do not simplify the core into two open wing-like curves.
Do not use generic concentric circles as the main structure.
Do not create a solid sphere.
Preserve the existing AtlasCore JavaScript state controller and all six states.
Prefer SVG paths plus generated surface point meshes, masks and gradients; Canvas/WebGL is acceptable if it achieves the reference more faithfully.
Validate against the original PNG side by side in the browser.
